_comment: The red-expected map (0.3.0, row 41): every mechanism of the kit, by the id tools/release.mjs reads from the tree (registry:<id> for a row of hooks/registry.json, guard:<n> for a numbered rule in the header of hooks/guard.mjs, claim:<type> for a case of the dispatcher switch in tools/doctor/claims.mjs, anchor:<file>#<name> for an anchor line in a tracked script), to the name of one or more cases that proved it red first: a case whose planted fault the mechanism refuses, reports or prints. The names are the exact record names of tools/tests/run.mjs (its cases-*.mjs and guard-cases.json), tools/doctor/selftest.mjs (and its selftest-*.mjs) and tools/tests/adopt-selftest.mjs; the release gate refuses a bump when a mechanism is missing here, when a name here was not printed by a suite, when its case failed, or when an id here names nothing in the tree. Keep it in tree order: the registry rows, the guard rules, the claim types, then the anchors by file.
